latin: Dico secundum Thommam dicendum esse in actu reflexo intellectus
translation: Following Thomas, I maintain that one must locate our beatitude in a reflexive act of the intellect.
translation_note: Farmer's note (farmer1998:20162) stresses that Pico here represents Thomas's own view, not his own (which he states more fully at 3>43); pico_stance is accordingly given as unstated.
